::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 21st 1866  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS BL Add.70949 f.387
:::

My dear [Miss Ingelow](people/person_741.qmd)
This is [Mr Stone](people/person_1371.qmd)’s answer about the [knight of Intercession](other_books/otherbook_453.qmd). It seems to be one of the legends that evades all search. How would it be to send a question to Notes and Queries? 

I have been wishing to tell you that the last sermon that I heard [Mr Keble](people/person_798.qmd) preach, a year and half ago, - one on the anniversary of his Church Consecration, he brought in a sentence about the Church bells sounding on the ear of travellers in the desert, and he told me afterwards that it came out of ‘[the one story by two Authors’](other_books/otherbook_278.qmd).[^1]

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: *One story by two authors; or, A tale without a moral* by Jean Ingelow and Frances Mary Levett was serialised in *MP* 1860-61 and published 'with additions' in 1862.
